Running head at top centre; page number top left; a brace-based diagram of italic lines in the body; a short note paragraph below the diagram; a right-aligned catchword-like line at the end. main_text.p: Nempe temperata existente qualitate, omnia ad mediocritatem reducuntur.
a. Subaureæ, subcroceæ, quòd calore liberè in toto corpore diffuso, atque præsenti materiæ dominante, concoctioneque facta ut decet, urinæ fiant mediocres.
b. Sed substantia & contentis tenuioribus, quòd principales partes tenuentur atque disperdantur aëris caliditate.

l.i: d. Contentis paucis & tenuibus, & quodam modo albis.

page.notes: Faint show-through from the facing page is present at the right and was omitted. The brace diagram is rendered as lines; the braced labels Alba, Lœui, Æquali are set beside a brace after "Tenuiore, sed". The word "Hypostasi" line is italic in the scan and was copied as printed.
